title: Regular closed immersion of pure codimension
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ and $Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], separated over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] and of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of $k$-schemes (commuting with their structure morphisms [def-weil-scheme-over-base]) and let $c\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$. For each $z\in Z$, write $R_z=\mathcal O_{X,i(z)}$, $S_z=\mathcal O_{Z,z}$, and $I_z=\ker(i_z^\sharp:R_z\to S_z)$, where $i_z^\sharp$ is the induced homomorphism of local rings [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. The immersion has *pure codimension $c$* in this chapter's sense if
$$
\dim R_z=\dim S_z+c\qquad\text{for every }z\in Z,
$$
where dimension is Krull dimension of a ring [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Such an immersion is *regular* if for every $z\in Z$ there are $f_1,\ldots,f_c\in R_z$ with $I_z=(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$ and $(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$ an $R_z$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Thus a *regular closed immersion of pure codimension $c$* in this setting satisfies both the displayed dimension equality and the regular generating-sequence condition at every point of $Z$.

blueprint_update.statement:
In the purity conventions of this chapter ([def-pur-conventions] fixed setting),
let $X$ be a separated
finite-type $k$-scheme and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a
closed immersion with
$Z$ separated of finite type and *pure codimension* $c\in \mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ in the sense that for every $z\in Z$ the local ring
$\mathcal O_{X,z}$ has Krull dimension $\dim\mathcal O_{Z,z}+c$. The
immersion is *regular* if for every $z\in Z$ the ideal of $Z$ in
$\mathcal O_{X,z}$ is generated by a regular sequence of length $c$.

Equivalently, by the linearization lemma, a pair of smooth schemes with a
regular immersion is etale-locally the linear pair.
